import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create a 2x2 subplot layout
fig, ((ax1, ax2), (ax3, ax4)) = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Distribution of dog ages over time
age_time = df.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'AlterVHundCd']).size().reset_index(name='Count')
pivot_age = age_time.pivot(index='StichtagDatJahr', columns='AlterVHundCd', values='Count').fillna(0)
pivot_age.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax1, colormap='viridis')
ax1.set_title('Dog Age Distribution Over Years', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Dog Age', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Distribution by Kreis (District)
kreis_dist = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
kreis_dist.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax2, color='steelblue')
ax2.set_title('Dogs by District (Kreis)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=12)

# 3. Top dog breeds
breed_counts = pd.concat([
    df[df['Rasse1Text'].notna()]['Rasse1Text'],
    df[df['Rasse2Text'].notna()]['Rasse2Text']
]).value_counts().head(10)
breed_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color='coral')
ax3.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Breed', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=10)

# 4. Owner age group distribution
owner_age = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

        startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax4.set_title('Dogs by Owner Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
